item.title: Tenant Screening and Credit Checks for Renters: What Landlords Look For
item.description:
Quick Answer

Landlords typically screen four things: credit, income (often a 3x-rent ratio), rental history, and background. Ask for the written criteria before you pay any fee, review your own credit report first, and submit a complete application packet to strengthen your odds. Tenant screening can feel like a black box, especially when you are paying fees and waiting on a decision. This guide breaks down what landlords typically review so you can prepare with confidence.
